traffic_gate_reason: initial: feature flag OFF (inline asyncio is the only path)
note: R2: traffic to Agent Engine is feature-flagged + p95-gated. Inline asyncio stays primary; Agent Engine is the documented Track 3 path. If Agent Engine p95 exceeds the gate multiplier × inline p95 over the rolling window, the gate auto-closes and subsequent requests fall back to inline. Three consecutive Agent Engine failures also close the gate. Each engine.query() call has a hard timeout (ACP_AGENT_ENGINE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_S, default 180s); a timeout is treated as a failure so the gate logic + fallback path still fire. Codex Day-19 P2: when the flag starts ON and no live inline samples exist, the gate compares against ACP_INLINE_P95_BASELINE_MS instead so the latency gate still fires.
